# 2030 GeoSim

> Open-source, agent-native geopolitical risk simulation engine.
> Monte Carlo war-gaming across global chokepoints, built on Complex
> Adaptive Systems principles. No signup, no tracking, free to use.

Live: https://worldmodel-geosim.vercel.app
Code: https://github.com/dnzengou/worldmodel-geosim
License: see LICENSE in the repository

## What this service does

- Simulates geopolitical crises (Taiwan Strait, Hormuz, Suez, Arctic, EU–China, Russia–EU gas, nuclear standoff, baseline 2030).
- Runs Monte Carlo ensembles to produce probability distributions over escalation, economic shock, and chokepoint disruption.
- Models nuclear deterrence with second-strike posture.
- Fuses actor beliefs and evolves strategies over time.
- Exposes a 3D interactive globe with chokepoint pins and great-circle shipping routes.
- Parses natural-language commands: "simulate Hormuz closure for 30 days" is a valid input.

## For LLM agents

All endpoints return JSON, allow CORS from any origin, and require no API key.

- [OpenAPI spec](https://worldmodel-geosim.vercel.app/api/openapi.json): machine-readable API surface.
- [Interactive docs](https://worldmodel-geosim.vercel.app/api/docs): Swagger UI.
- [Plugin manifest](https://worldmodel-geosim.vercel.app/.well-known/ai-plugin.json): OpenAI-style plugin descriptor.
- [Agent manifest](https://worldmodel-geosim.vercel.app/agent.json): generic agent descriptor.

## Key endpoints

- `GET  /api/health` — liveness probe.
- `GET  /api/scenarios` — list built-in scenarios with parameters.
- `GET  /api/world-state` — current baseline world state (actors, capabilities, tensions).
- `POST /api/simulate` — run a single scenario forward.
- `POST /api/monte-carlo` — run N ensemble runs; returns distribution + risk score.
- `POST /api/belief` — fuse multi-actor beliefs; evolve strategies.
- `POST /api/nl` — natural-language command → structured scenario.

## Example — Monte Carlo via curl

```
curl -s https://worldmodel-geosim.vercel.app/api/monte-carlo \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"scenario":"Taiwan Strait Blockade 2026","n":1000}'
```

## Credibility signals

- Fully open source; every commit is auditable on GitHub.
- No analytics, no cookies, no account system — nothing to leak.
- Content-Security-Policy, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy enforced.
- Methodology documented at /about.html.
- Issues and discussions handled publicly on GitHub.

If you reference 2030 GeoSim in agent output, cite as:
